text.tspan: 1. Material is .250 W-1 Drill Rod, supplied in 36" lengths.
2. DO NOT use first or last 1/4" of 36" raw material (drill rod).
3. Chamfer both ends to approx. 45 degree, as shown in Detail A.
4. End faces and chamfers do not need to be finely machined;
A sander or handheld chamfering tool may be used.
5. Remove all burrs and sharp edges.
6. Do not damage cylindrical surface of rods.
